STORYTIME ADVENTURES

Twenty-nine story games you play with pictures.

Sequencing, clues, feelings, retelling, memory and story paths — real comprehension games played on our own storybook artwork, with spoken instructions and no reading required.

This way to Class 29 →The class that goes with these adventures: Storytime & Pre-Reading Comprehension.
1 Cleared! Bunny’s Growing GardenPlant the seed, water the sprout, watch the flower grow — tap Bunny’s day in the right order.Story sequencing Play → 2 Cleared! Teddy’s Missing BackpackLook around Teddy’s room, follow the clues, and find where the backpack waits.Using picture clues Play → 3 Cleared! Little Lion’s FeelingsA gift, a dropped ice cream, a popped balloon — match each story to the feeling it brings.Feelings in stories Play → 4 Cleared! Fox’s Rainy Day SurpriseThe sun was out, then the rain came down — predict what Fox does next with the umbrella he found.Predicting what happens next Play → 5 Cleared! Mouse’s Story Retelling TrainMixing, baking, munching — load each picture onto the right train car: beginning, middle or end.Beginning, middle, end Play → 12 Cleared! Beaver’s Story BridgeGather logs, build the bridge, cross the river — tap what happened FIRST and what happened LAST.First and last Play → 14 Cleared! Rabbit’s Hidden CluesSnowy, rainy, hungry — read Rabbit’s clues and tap the thing Rabbit needs.What do you need? Play → 15 Cleared! Penguin’s Silly Story FixA toothbrush on a sneaker, a bicycle in a nest — tap the picture that makes the story make sense.Does it make sense? Play → 16 Cleared! Butterfly’s Story JourneyGarden to pond to forest to meadow — tap the stops on Butterfly’s journey, in order, and skip the silly ones.Story order on a journey Play → 17 Cleared! Raccoon’s Memory ChallengeA red blanket, two apples, a blue cup — look hard, then tap what you remember.Story memory Play → 18 Cleared! Dragon’s Story Ending StudioA planted seed, baking day, a bike ride — tap the ending that truly fits each story.Story endings Play → 19 Cleared! Fox’s Story Shadow MysteryMuddy footprints, an empty cookie plate, a tipped flowerpot — three mysteries, solved with clues.Reading picture clues Play → 20 Cleared! Turtle’s Story TimelinePack the basket, picnic, wash the dishes — tap what happened BEFORE the picnic and AFTER it.Before and after Play → 21 Cleared! Koala’s Character DetectiveA gardener, a baker, a mail carrier — match each character to the job they did in the story.Characters and actions Play → 22 Cleared! Elephant’s Story SurpriseA party hat, three candles, a gift from Monkey — answer the questions about Elephant’s surprise.Story questions Play → 23 Cleared! Every card is one real game. 29 of the planned 30 adventures are playable now — 24, Unicorn's Story Choice Garden, joins the moment its artwork is uploaded. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What each game practises.

The collection climbs one slope: ordering stories (Bunny’s garden, Squirrel’s morning, Panda’s kite, Mouse’s train), reading picture clues (Teddy’s backpack, Rabbit’s needs, Giraffe’s detective, Otter’s hunt), matching feelings and characters (Little Lion, Owl’s world, Koala’s detective), reasoning about problems and best choices (Puppy’s helping hands, Little Bear’s decision, Squirrel’s connections), and remembering, predicting and fixing stories (Raccoon’s memory, Dragon’s endings, Penguin’s silly fixes, Turtle’s timeline, Ladybug’s missing scene, Little Deer’s paths) — up to the castle challenge that mixes them all.

Say the prompt aloud with the game, ask “why do you think so?”, and let the giggles at the silly answers do the teaching. Every worksheet twin prints without a screen.
